Tensor 可以先理解为：: For this course, think of a tensor as:
带有shape、dtype、device 等信息的多维数字容器。: A multidimensional numerical container with shape, dtype, device, and related metadata.
这个定义里的每一部分都有实际作用：: Each part has a practical purpose:
数字内容告诉operation 要计算什么；: The values are the data an operation computes with;
dtype 决定每个数字怎样存储和可以参加哪些运算；: Dtype describes numerical storage and affects supported operations;
device 决定运算在CPU、GPU 或其他加速器上执行；: Device identifies where the data and compatible computation reside, such as CPU or an accelerator;
autograd metadata 记录它是否需要gradient 以及怎样回到: Autograd metadata relates the tensor to gradient tracking and previous operations.
Tensor 不是一种新数学。它把Week 1 的scalar、vector 和: A tensor is not a new set of arithmetic rules. It places Week 1's scalars, vectors, and matrices behind a common interface.
为什么Python List 不够: Why not just use Python lists?
Python list 可以保存数字，却不是为大规模数值计算设计的。对百万个元素: Lists can store numbers, but a Python loop over millions of elements incurs interpreter overhead. Lists also do not provide a shared interface for tensor shapes, accelerator devices, and automatic differentiation.
Tensor 把同类数字排列成规则内存，并把整个operation 交给经过优化: A dense tensor gives numerical data a structured layout and passes whole operations to optimized lower-level kernels:
底层并行计算大量乘加操作: A lower-level kernel performs many multiply-and-add calculations
Autograd 同时记录这次依赖关系: Autograd records the dependency when gradient tracking is enabled and needed
因此Tensor 是数学、硬件加速和Backpropagation 的共同数据载: Tensors are the common data representation linking the mathematics, accelerated operations, and backpropagation.

把tensor 移到GPU 不是给它加一个标签，而是把真实数据复制到另一块内存。: Moving data from CPU to GPU can require copying it into different memory. Repeated transfers have a cost. A common approach keeps the model on the chosen device, transfers each input/target batch there, and brings back only the values needed for reporting. Bias 的语义是“同一组neuron biases 应用于batch 中每个e: The intended bias operation is “use this same set of neuron biases for every example.” Without broadcasting, we might first create explicit repeated rows:

能广播不等于语义正确。例如[B,T,C] + [T,1] 可能运行成功，但你原本: Broadcastable does not mean semantically correct. For example, [B,T,C]+[T,1] can run even if the intended addition was a [C] bias. When a result is surprising, align shapes from the right and explain why each repeated axis is intended.

通常只有需要学习的浮点parameters 设置requires_grad=Tr: For these examples, set requires_grad=True on the floating-point parameters to learn. Inputs and targets need not have their own gradients computed. Other tasks can require input gradients, so this is a choice for our training setup rather than a universal restriction.
requires_grad 不是“这个tensor 已经有gradient”，而: requires_grad=True does not mean a gradient has already been calculated. It enables tracking for later differentiation. For a leaf parameter used by the loss, backward then accumulates the numerical result into .grad.
直接创建并作为parameter 使用的w、b 通常是leaf tensors。: Directly created w and b used as parameters here are leaf tensors. Predictions, errors, and loss produced from them are intermediate tensors with grad_fn describing their differentiation history.
Optimizer 主要持有leaf parameters；中间tensors: An optimizer normally holds references to persistent leaf parameters. Intermediate tensors connect the current computation and are not themselves the learned model state.
这行代码从scalar loss 开始执行Week 4 的反向传播。: This line starts Week 4's backward calculation from the scalar loss.
PyTorch 并没有“猜” gradient。它按照记录下来的graph，调用: PyTorch does not guess the gradients. It follows the recorded dependencies and combines the operations' local derivatives using the chain rule.
为什么通常对Scalar Loss 调用Backward: Why usually call backward on a scalar loss?
loss.backward() 隐含的起点是：: The implicit starting seed for loss.backward() is:
如果对一个多元素tensor 直接backward，就必须额外指定每个元素怎样被: For a multi-element output, backward needs a supplied gradient vector specifying how the output components contribute. A scalar mean loss defines one objective and allows an implicit seed of 1. For squared-error regression, average the per-example losses—not the signed errors that could cancel.
w.grad 不是新weight，也不是本次应该直接加多少。它是当前位置：: w.grad is neither the new weight nor a quantity to add directly to w. It is the current:
Optimizer 还会结合learning rate、momentum 等规则: The optimizer uses it with the learning rate and any other update rules, such as momentum, to determine the actual parameter change.
loss.backward() 不传额外参数时，通常要求 loss 只有一个元素: Without an explicit gradient argument, loss.backward() normally requires a single-element output. If you have a vector of per-sample losses, first use .mean() or .sum() to define the objective. Vector outputs can also be differentiated, but the backward seed must be specified. Differentiation is not restricted to scalar-valued functions.
PyTorch 默认会累加gradients：: PyTorch accumulates gradients into .grad by default:
这对某些算法有用，但标准training loop 每一步通常要先清零：: This is useful in some workflows, but a standard independent training step normally clears previous gradients:
如果忘记，下一步update 会混入前面batches 的gradients。: Otherwise, the next update includes contributions left over from previous backward calls.
为什么默认设计成累加？因为同一个parameter 可能通过多条路径被使用，或用: Accumulation across backward calls supports deliberate schemes such as combining several small batches before one update. The training loop chooses when to clear that stored accumulation. This is distinct from summing multiple dependency paths within one backward calculation, which is mathematically required.
标准顺序通常是先zero_grad() 再forward。只要每个step 恰好: A clear standard sequence puts zero_grad() before forward. Clearing at the end of the previous completed update can also work, provided gradients are cleared at the intended boundary. Putting it at the start makes that boundary easy to see.
同一次计算图中多个分支: Multiple paths within one computation graph
同一参数确实影响多个位置: The same parameter affects several parts of the objective
反向传播必须汇总，不能删掉分支: Backward must combine these contributions; do not omit paths
普通独立 step 先 zero_grad；有意积累则另定窗口: Clear it before an independent step, or explicitly define an accumulation window
在第一次 backward 前，parameter.grad 通常是 None，: Before the first backward call, parameter.grad is usually None, so calling parameter.grad.zero_() unconditionally can fail. optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) clears stored gradients by setting them to None. No stored gradient and a stored all-zero tensor are different states. Week 11 discusses intentional accumulation.
更新时不应该把“更新操作本身”继续记录到下一张graph：: Our update should not become another differentiable operation linking the training iterations:
这里的w 是requires_grad=True 的leaf tensor；在t: Here w is a leaf tensor with requires_grad=True. An in-place update such as w -= ... in normal grad mode is rejected with a RuntimeError. Replacing it with the out-of-place w = w - ... can instead create a non-leaf tensor carrying history and connect iterations. Put the manual parameter update inside torch.no_grad(), or use the standard optimizer.step() shown here.

12. nn.Module：组织Parameters 和Forward: 12. nn.Module: organize parameters and forward computation
真实模型不应手工管理大量parameters。: Larger models need a systematic way to manage parameters.
model(x) 会调用forward(x)，同时保留framework 所需的: Call model(x), which invokes forward through the module's call machinery and preserves the expected hook behavior. Differentiable tensor operations inside forward are recorded when grad mode requires it.
nn.Module 为什么不仅是代码封装: Why nn.Module is more than a wrapper
普通class 也能写forward，但nn.Module 还维护一棵可遍历的模: A plain class can define forward too. nn.Module additionally maintains a registered model structure. Assigning an nn.Parameter or child module to self allows the framework to:
model.parameters() 收集可训练参数: Collect registered parameters through model.parameters(); requires_grad determines whether each needs gradients
递归移动参数和buffers: Move registered parameters and buffers recursively between devices
model.state_dict() 保存可恢复状态: Export parameters and persistent buffers through model.state_dict()
model.train()/eval() 切换子模块运行模式: Set the training/evaluation mode of registered submodules
因此Module registration 是训练框架能够管理模型生命周期的基础: Registration lets the framework consistently manage the model's components.
nn.Linear(1,1) 默认随机初始化，因此直接运行未必和手算第一步相同。: nn.Linear(1,1) initializes parameters randomly, so its default first step will not match our hand calculation. For a fair Week 2 comparison, zero both weight and bias inside no_grad first. Its weight shape is [1,1]; the general storage rule is [outputs,inputs]. For row-wise samples, forward is X @ weight.T + bias. See course_examples/week05_three_ways.py for all three implementations.
loss_function → 衡量prediction 有多差: Loss function → score predictions against targets
Loss function 和optimizer 被分开，是因为它们回答不同问题: The loss defines the objective; the optimizer defines how to use gradients to change parameters. A model can be trained with different objectives, and a loss can be paired with different optimizers. Backpropagation supplies the parameter gradients connecting them.

Prediction 和target 是否对齐；: Whether predictions and targets are correctly aligned;
